text:
maya: Heads-up — visiting Tokyo 4/15-4/18 for product offsite. Team of 8 (2 vegetarians). Friday evening dinner near Shinagawa station — any izakaya/ramen/vegetarian picks that take groups? Prefer places that allow reservations. ETA 19:00. Thanks!
sam: Ooh! For group yakitori, Torikizoku is cheap and close but tables are small — might have to split the group. Not the best for vegetarians tho. :thumbsup:
hiro: If you want veg-friendly ramen, try T's Tantan at Shinagawa (completely vegan ramen). Usually quick turnover but for 8 call ahead. Phone: `03-3787-XXXX`.
anya: +1 for T's Tantan. Another option is Umegaoka Sushino Midori (sushi) — long lines but great and they take walk-ins; for 8 you'd better reserve. They have an online reservation form.
tom: For an atmospheric group izakaya with a private room, check out the little alleys by Shinagawa Yokocho — a few places have 8-person tatami rooms. I booked once by phone: `03-3999-YYYY`. Might need a Japanese speaker to hold the call.
lee: If you want a calmer dinner with proper veg options and table booking, try Cafe & Dining Natori (near East exit). They accept group reservations online and have mains under ¥6,000. Link: https://natori.example.jp/reserve (call to confirm).
maya: Amazing, thanks everyone! Quick logistics Qs — any tips on cash vs card and a short phrase we can use when calling (we have two non-Japanese speakers)? Also want to keep it under ~¥6k per person if possible.
hiro: Most izakayas are cash-first, smaller places sometimes card-not-accepted. Bring some yen. For reservation phrase: say `hachinin, shichi-ji, kin-en onegaishimasu` (8 people, 7pm, non-smoking please). If you want I can DM my friend who can call in Japanese and secure a booking.
maya: That would be amazing @hiro — thanks! I'll follow up in DMs and share final headcount later. :pray:
sam: If you need ramen backup for a quicker option, 'Ippudo' near the station turns fast — easy fallback.
anya: Also FYI: peak Fri nights are busy, so book asap if you want a single table.
maya: Noted — booking tonight. Appreciate all the recs! :tada:
